PH.D. THESIS & WORK

Thesis Title: “Identity Based Intelligent Security System in IoT Environment”.Research Supervisor: Dr. Chandra Prakash Patidar (Associate Professor, IT Department, IET-DAVV, Indore).Research Work: The research work is focused on the development of a secure and intelligent IoT-based smart home system that integrates automation, environmental monitoring, and advanced authentication mechanisms. The proposed system combines RFID-based identification and face recognition using OpenCV and Python to provide dual-layer access control, enhancing home security and personalized automation. Various sensors, including DHT11/DHT22 for temperature and humidity, MQ2/MQ135 for gas detection, LDR for light sensing, and voice modules, enable real-time monitoring and smart device control. The system is implemented using Raspberry Pi and ESP32 microcontrollers, supporting Wi-Fi and Bluetooth communication. To improve connectivity and scalability, LoRa and LoRaWAN technologies with optimized packet transmission algorithms were studied using NS3 simulations, enhancing network performance and coverage through multi-hop communication. An RFID-ESP32-based device authentication framework was also developed for smart buildings. Comparative evaluation of face recognition algorithms used as LBPH, Eigenface (PCA), and Dlib CNN. After implementation and performance evaluation, the LBPH (Local Binary Pattern Histogram) algorithm, enhanced with a dynamic threshold approach, demonstrated the best balance of recognition accuracy, responsiveness, and robustness, making it highly suitable for resource-constrained IoT systems and real-world smart home deployments.
MASTER’S THESIS & PROJECT WORK

Thesis Title: “Improving Stored Data Security in Cloud using RC5 Algorithm”.Description There are big security concerns when using cloud services. Security is very important in cloud computing since people and companies store confidential data in the cloud. However, user's files are not encrypted at some open source public cloud storage systems, so the storage service provider or outside world can easily access the user's files. This brings a big concern about user's privacy. Here work is focused on RC5 Encryption Algorithm for stored data in cloud. Resulted encrypted method is secure and easy to use; it fulfills the needs of cloud users and providers. The methods have been implemented in a fully working environment solution that uses cloud environment.
